protocol.m4_dev: 100 monthly series sampled uniformly at random (seed 2026) from the 48,000 monthly series of the M4 competition dataset (100,000 series in total), each truncated to its last 36 observations; development data
protocol.m4_test: 100 further monthly series (seed 2027) drawn from the 47,900 M4 monthly series not in M4_DEV, same truncation; held out in Stage 2 and evaluated then; re-run here with the Stage 8 code, so it is no longer unseen
protocol.m4_test_large: 1,000 further monthly series (seed 2028) drawn from the 47,800 M4 monthly series in neither earlier sample, same truncation; drawn after the Stage 8 design was frozen and evaluated once
